raw_text: BREAKING: Sources at Kamra confirm arrival of first batch of JF-17 Block 3 aircraft from Chengdu. At least 4 airframes spotted in crates at PAC facility. This is the AESA-equipped variant with KLJ-7A radar and PL-15 integration. Major capability upgrade for PAF's frontline squadrons.
